posts.text:
Small tasks stick to you like sticky notes.

One reply. One invoice. One quick update. Each is small. Together they weigh more than the big goal waiting ahead.

Peel a few off this week. Which one goes first?

#Productivity #Delegation #Focus
Growth needs space. Make some. What would you grow with a clear desk?

The right support makes the work lighter, not smaller.

You keep the vision and the decisions. Others carry the sandbags.

What is the heaviest sandbag in your business right now?

#Business #Delegation #Founders
